gloss: dressed meat; butchered meat for sale

definitions.gloss: dressed meat; butchered meat ready for sale
definitions.explanation: Meat that has been processed and prepared for retail sale, as distinct from a live animal or whole carcass. Commonly seen as a department label in supermarkets.

examples.japanese: {精肉|せいにく}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{豚肉|ぶたにく}→豚肉：02956_butaniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought pork at the meat counter.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{精肉|せいにく}{店|てん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{牛肉|ぎゅうにく}→牛肉：02874_gyuuniku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: That butcher shop is famous for high-quality beef.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精肉|せいにく}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{国産|こくさん}→国産：12017_kokusan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦{並|なら}べられている→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: At the supermarket meat section, domestic and imported meats are displayed separately.

notes:
A compound of {精|せい} (refined, processed) and ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (meat). Refers to meat that has been butchered and prepared for cooking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精肉|せいにく}{店|てん} (butcher shop)
- {精肉|せいにく}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧ (meat section in a supermarket)
- {精肉|せいにく}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧ (meat sales area)

In Japanese supermarkets, the main fresh food departments are typically labeled ⟦{青果|せいか}→青果：14825_seika⟧ (produce), {精肉|せいにく} (meat), ⟦{鮮魚|せんぎょ}→鮮魚：16483_sengyo⟧ (fresh fish), and ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧ (prepared foods/deli).
